narrative.intro: Spencer Construction has $2.4B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Spencer Construction won 5 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $472M. Spencer Construction obligations are up 321227.1% year over year. Spencer Construction totals for the current year are partial because the fiscal year is still in progress. Spencer Construction posted no obligations in FY21 and FY24. Spencer Construction recorded $15.3M in FY22, $72.9K in FY23, and $735K in FY25. Spencer Construction current-year activity is highly concentrated in FY26, which accounts for the majority of the reported federal obligations. Spencer Construction award count and average award size indicate a small number of very large awards are driving the year-to-date total. Spencer Construction readers should note that the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables report total contract values rather than obligations, and the page summarizes obligations unless otherwise labeled as award values.

sections.heading: How has Spencer Construction's federal activity trended over recent fiscal years?
sections.body: Spencer Construction obligations were $0 in FY21 and FY24, $15.3M in FY22, $72.9K in FY23, and $735K in FY25 before jumping to $2.4B in FY26.
